name: Reuben
overview: Reuben is the firstborn son of Jacob and Leah, belonging to the tribe of Reuben. He is male and holds the unique distinction of being Jacob's eldest son, as explicitly stated in Genesis 29:32. There are no additional personal notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Reuben means 'see, a son,' reflecting his birth as noted in Genesis 29:32. This proper name was not given directly by God but by his parents, emphasizing his position as a son observed by his mother.
familyAndRelationships: Reuben is the son of Jacob and Leah and has several brothers, including Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, and Dinah as a sister, all born of Leah. He also has half-brothers Dan, Naphtali, Gad, Asher, Joseph, and Benjamin, born of other mothers. Additionally, Hanoch is noted as his father in Genesis 46:9, which may refer to a descendant sharing his name.
scriptureSignificance: Reuben's role as the firstborn son of Jacob positioned him to receive the birthright and a double portion, yet he forfeited these privileges due to his transgression with his father's concubine Bilhah. Despite this failure, he demonstrated responsibility by attempting to protect Joseph from harm and offering his sons as a pledge for Benjamin's safety. His story illustrates that God's sovereign choices transcend human customs such as birth order, highlighting the importance of character and divine will in biblical history.

keyEvents.event: Offered his sons as surety for Benjamin
